name: Hibi Akiha
source:
Tsukihime short erotic novel depicting exciting day for Shiki and Akiha. There is also a story of Shiki x Ren as an extra.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
